description: There is no SKILL.md (or equivalent onboarding doc) for skills/earn/pm-trade/, unlike sibling earn slots (e.g. skills/earn/x402-sell/SKILL.md, skills/earn/video/SKILL.md, skills/earn/gig/SLOT_CC.md exist for their slots). Per this project's own building-agents rule (skill = NL instructions + deterministic tools, the model does judgment), the model driving the ReAct loop has no documented interface telling it that lib.py's position_size/kelly_fraction/arb_pair_profit exist, what units they expect, or how to invoke them (there isn't even a CLI to invoke — see FIND-001). Without this, the model has no discoverable path to actually use the Quarter-Kelly sizing math REQ-PMTRADE mandates.

evidence.snippet: no SKILL.md present; compare skills/earn/x402-sell/SKILL.md, skills/earn/video/SKILL.md which exist for sibling slots
